# Note: "Google Favicon" and "Google Web Preview" were previously listed here.
# Those tokens contain spaces, which makes the whole group invalid under
# RFC 9309 -- crawlers ignore it entirely, so those rules never did anything.
# Removed rather than "fixed", since neither is a real Googlebot token.
